Make finance processes work better, from end to end

Do you enjoy turning complex finance challenges into practical, well-controlled ways of working? Join the Global Finance Processes team at Scan Global Logistics A/S and help shape consistent processes that connect finance, business operations and technology.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Finance Process Manager to drive the design, implementation and continuous improvement of global finance processes. This role is central to ensuring consistency, efficiency and compliance across financial operations globally. The ideal candidate brings a blend of strong finance acumen, operational excellence and consulting experience(preferred), with the ability to lead change across diverse geographies and teams.

Key Responsibilities

• Process Design, Documentation & Implementation: Lead the development and standardization of global finance processes across accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, reporting and other core finance functions. Facilitate process design workshops with cross-functional stakeholders, and define, document and maintain comprehensive process maps and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure consistency, efficiency and compliance across regions and teams.

• Gap Analysis & Remediation: Identify process inefficiencies, control weaknesses and regional deviations, and implement actionable solutions to close gaps and enhance process maturity.

• Training & Change Management: Design and deliver training programs for regional finance teams to support the adoption of new processes and compliance with global standards.

• Project Management: Manage and support cross-functional finance transformation projects in partnership with IT, business operations, regional finance teams and external consultants, as needed.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with key internal stakeholders, including Finance Leadership and Internal Audit, as well as external auditors, to align on process goals and ensure operational readiness.

• Continuous Improvement: Establish a culture of continuous improvement by regularly soliciting feedback, conducting process reviews, analyzing performance data and introducing best practices.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field.

• 5+ years of progressive experience in finance operations, including at least 2–3 years in a management consulting or finance transformation role.

• Proven experience leading global finance initiatives in a matrixed, multinational environment.

• Strong project management skills; experience with Lean, Six Sigma or other continuous improvement methodologies is an advantage.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Familiarity with automation and AI technologies

• Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence without direct authority.

Preferred Experience

• Strong knowledge of finance processes, including procure-to-pay (P2P), order-to-cash (O2C) and record-to-report (R2R).

• Experience with ERP systems including Microsoft Dynamics 365, and finance automation tools.

• Proficiency in process mapping tools, such as Microsoft Visio.

• Proven experience developing, writing and maintaining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and detailed process documentation.

• Familiarity with internal controls and regulatory requirements.

• Experience working in a shared services or global business services (GBS) environment.

Key Competencies

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving

• Strong finance acumen

• Process mindset and attention to detail

• Project management and execution

• Influencing and cross-functional collaboration

What the role offers

You will contribute to global standards with practical relevance to local teams, work across finance, business operations and technology, and help strengthen the foundations for scalable ways of working. The role offers exposure to varied business challenges and the opportunity to see your analysis become clearer processes, stronger controls and less rework.

Your role will report directly into Head of Global finance processes

About us

Scan Global Logistics is a Nordic-based full-service global logistics provider present on all continents. From businesses across all industries to life-saving humanitarian organizations, we go above and beyond to bring anything anywhere – whether by road, rail, ocean or air.

We are guided by our fundamental virtues of Respect, Entrepreneurship, Integrity, and Fun and strive to bring a human approach to everyone, everywhere.

We run on the energy of good people, and no system or formula can compensate for that. Therefore, we also do what we can to unlock every employee's personal and professional potential so we can grow and thrive together.

Interested?

Please send us your CV and application in english. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the process when the right candidate has been found.

For further information, please contact Shaina Bano, Head of Global Finance Processes, UP Process Lead, +45 7181 7413 or visit www.scangl.com.

**Senior Data Analyst – SAP Reporting & Stakeholder Alignment

**

• Work model: Hybrid

• Contract type: Permanent

Are you passionate about turning business questions into meaningful data solutions? Do you enjoy working with stakeholders, solving complex data challenges, and transforming data into insights that drive better decisions? Then you might be the person we are looking for.

As our new Senior Data Analyst, you will join the Data & Insights team and report directly to the Head of Data & Insights. In this role, you will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and SAP data, ensuring reporting requirements are clearly defined, translated into actionable data solutions, and delivered with accuracy and impact.

You will work closely with Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, and Data Engineering teams to support data-driven decision-making while improving reporting processes and data quality across the organization. This is a great opportunity to influence business decisions, collaborate across functions, and help shape the future of data and analytics at STG.

**What Your Day Will Look Like

**In this role, you will typically focus on:

• Partner directly with business stakeholders — Finance leadership, Sales/Commercial, Supply Chain/Operations — to understand their reporting and data needs, and translate them into concrete data requirements.

• Work closely with data engineers to scope, request, and validate data pulled from SAP, acting as the translation layer between business language and technical/data specifications.

• Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, validate, and consolidate data for recurring and ad hoc reporting.

• Build and maintain Excel-based models, trackers, and reports that stakeholders rely on for decision-making.

• Consolidate data into stakeholder-ready reporting, and supporting data checks.

• Act as the go-to person for scoping ambiguous stakeholder requests — clarifying what's actually needed, managing expectations, and pushing back constructively when a request isn't well-defined or feasible.

• Identify data quality issues at the source and work with SAP module owners and data engineers to resolve them.

• Document data definitions, sources, and logic so reporting stays consistent and auditable month over month.

• Continuously look for ways to streamline the process rather than repeating manual work each cycle.

**What You'll Bring

**

• 5+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar data-facing role, ideally in a retail or consumer business.

• Strong SQL skills — comfortable writing and troubleshooting complex queries independently.

• Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data modeling; Power Query is a plus).

• Familiarity with SAP data structures, particularly FI (Finance) and SD (Sales & Distribution).

• Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), or willingness to learn it, is a plus.

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Business, Economics, Finance, Data/Statistics, Engineering, or related).

• Proven experience gathering requirements from business stakeholders and translating them into technical/data specifications.

• Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align multiple stakeholders (including Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, and IT/data engineering) with sometimes competing priorities, and communicate trade-offs clearly.

• Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity and turning it into a structured plan.

**Working At STG & What To Expect

Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.

At STG you'll find more than a role. You'll find opportunities to grow, learn from talented colleagues, and contribute to initiatives that help drive business performance across a global organization.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,500+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential.

Why This Role is Important to Us

We are looking for Software Engineers at middle level to join our engineering team that builds fintech solutions for managing OTC (Over-The-Counter) financial instruments within our asset management platform, SimCorp Dimension and SimCorp One. Our work delivers value in two major areas. First, we implement new features that drive the business forward and shape the future of our platform. Second, we focus on extending and maintaining our established solutions to ensure our clients’ operations remain uninterrupted and always available.

What You Will Be Responsible For

• 
Designing, building, and extending existing solutions and APIs for our OTC asset management product, delivering value to customers incrementally.

• 
Working primarily in C#. Our codebase also includes OCaml and APL therefore prior experience with these languages is a strong plus.

• 
Understanding, refactoring and modernizing our legacy codebase without disrupting the business it supports.

• 
Focusing on the systems as a whole and being able address fundamental changes that improves the quality, performance and user experience.

• 
Collaborating closely with your product owner to refine requirements, clarify business needs, and shape how features get built.

• 
Working as part of a team of skilled engineers — pairing, reviewing code, and sharing ownership of the solution with fellow engineers.

Following good engineering practice: clean code, automated testing, and CI/CD.

• 
Building, extending and consuming REST APIs.

• 
Communicating clearly with both technical and business stakeholders.

Continuously learning — and helping the team and product grow with you.

Do you want to help build one coherent way for a global technology organization to deliver, bringing scaled product-centric ways of working project and program execution _together into a single system, rather than running them as separate worlds? Are you as comfortable helping shape that system and turning it into ways of working people actually use in the room with the people who'll actually use it?_We are hiring a Manager, Delivery Enablement to help shape and evolve how Pandora's D&T organization delivers. D&T spans the full range of technology that keeps Pandora running: from customer-facing platforms to manufacturing systems, ERP, logistics and operations, security, covering build, run, and operate across all of it. This role does not carry people-management responsibility. Your impact comes through the quality of what you build and how well it lands across the organization.

You'll join Delivery Enablement, a team combining operating-model design and implementation, coaching, and delivery tooling capability. It's built to make Digital & Technology (D&T) faster, clearer, and more coherent at scale. Delivery Enablement sits within Delivery Excellence, alongside the Scrum Masters, Delivery Leads, and Project and Program Managers. You will work with the wider team to shape ideas and turn them into practical ways of working across D&T.

**Your Role

**You will help harmonize and evolve how scaled agile delivery and more structured, plan-driven delivery work together, building on what already exists across D&T rather than replacing it, closing gaps only where they cause real friction. This is as much about leading change as it is about designing structure. You will also advise on structuring new or reshaping delivery entities (product lines, programs, organizational changes, or other setups) as they take shape, and help teams and entities build the capability to adopt the model as it evolves.

You will work closely with the wider delivery community, as well as product, engineering, and leadership more broadly, to facilitate structural workshops, build the case for change, and make sure what gets designed is something people actually want to use, not just a document on a shelf. A key part of the role is building the relationships, networks and momentum needed to bring ideas to life across D&T.

**

• Co-design and evolve how scaled agile and structured, plan-driven delivery work together, harmonizing and building on existing practice rather than replacing it

• Advise on structuring new or reshaping delivery entities (product lines, programs, organizational changes, or other setups) as they take shape

• Lead workstreams that take new or improved delivery processes (for example dependency management or capacity planning) from idea through pilot, rollout, adoption and continuous improvement

• Support onboarding and capability-building for teams and entities adopting the model, working alongside the team's wider coaching capability

• Facilitate structural workshops and working sessions with the wider delivery community to shape and pressure-test the model

• Build relationships, networks and communities that help change spread and stick across D&T

• Pilot approaches, learn from feedback, and scale what works

• Help translate high-level decisions about how delivery is prioritized, funded, resourced, and executed into practical structures and standards teams can use

• Help projects and programs connect into the wider D&T Operating Model, including common governance, planning, dependency management and delivery tooling

• Contribute to keeping the model coherent as it evolves, spotting where new structures overlap or conflict with what already exists

• Provide point-in-time advisory support where operating-model gaps are most costly

• Document how the operating model works and how it evolves over time

• Build strong relationships across the wider delivery community and leadership to ensure what gets built is genuinely adopted

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**

• ignificant experience in delivery transformation, operating-model implementation, PMO, program/project delivery or organizational change within a large, complex technology organization

• Demonstrated experience working across both scaled/product-centric agile delivery and more structured, plan-driven delivery, with enough understanding to contribute credibly to how they work together

• Track record of taking new ways of working from idea through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement

• Ideally a mix of hands-on delivery experience and consulting or advisory experience, but real, first-hand delivery experience matters more than advisory polish alone

• Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and narrative-building skills across senior and operational levels

• Comfortable leading through organizational change: helping people, not just structures, adapt as delivery models shift

• Able to build trust, networks and momentum without relying on formal authority

• Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your own analysis, design, and documentation work

• Working understanding of how delivery tooling (e.g. Jira/Confluence, or equivalent) underpins an operating model, enough to design frameworks that translate into practice, not to configure the tooling yourself

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity: building on foundations already in motion, while still shaping significant parts of the model from scratch

• Systems thinking: able to see cross-domain and cross-entity dependencies, not just local fixes

• Pragmatic bias toward incremental, adoptable change over comprehensive upfront design

• Relevant certifications (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe) are an advantage

At Factbird, we help manufacturers see what’s really happening on their lines, so they can make better, faster decisions. Our plug-and-play hardware and cloud platform turn live production data into clear insights, and we’re scaling fast across sites, teams, and countries.

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior IoT Solutions Engineer to join Engineering Services, the team that takes on the technical problems that fall outside what our product and Support handle today. You’ll look at a PLC, a sensor, or a 20-year-old CNC and work out how to get its data into Factbird. Sales and Support turn to you when the answer is “it depends,” and you turn that into a clear yes, no, or “here’s how.” Then you write it down so the next person doesn’t need to ask.

About the role

Engineering Services solves the hardest technical problems, documents them, and shares the knowledge, so Factbird gets smarter and the same problem doesn’t come back. You’ll answer feasibility questions before deals close, design and build custom solutions, and fix the cross-domain problems no other team can place.

**

The team mission we are on:** Engineering Services is a small team of experts finding solutions to a wide variety of challenges. In pre-sales we are supporting our AE's and Solution Consultants with feasibility testing the most complex customer setups or requirements. Often directly with the customers and their technical teams. In post-sales we collaborate with Cloud, FW and HW teams, and build and support a range of custom solutions. Our core mission is to increase documentation, standardization and empowering our colleagues in both pre- and post-sales roles to server the customers in the most technical cases.

What You'll Do

• Answer feasibility questions from Sales: can we connect this machine, PLC, or sensor, and how

• Design and build custom solutions: logic boxes, signal converters, IO-Link modules, EDGE flows, and Factbird® powered by OMRON NX1 programs that fill gaps the cloud platform can’t handle yet.

• Design the integration: map the customer’s OT/IT environment and plan the data sources, tag structures, transformations, and security.

• Root cause troubleshooting in live production. Smaller share of time, highest stakes

• Document everything you build and fix: Solution Records, runbooks, and wiring guides for customers and internal teams, clear enough that someone else can pick it up. Version and back up every configuration.

• Bench-test hardware before it ships, test the full data flow end to end (including failure recovery and restarts), and hand hardware to Logistics with a clear packing list.

• Integrate customer systems through Kepware, Ignition, OPC UA, MQTT, EtherNet/IP, Modbus, and Node-RED.

• Share what you know: help Support, Solution Consultants, and Hardware handle more on their own.

• Streamline as you go: spot repeat work and clunky processes, and fix them or flag them. Build templates and scripts that make the next delivery faster.

• Turn repeat workarounds into product input with a business case, so the workaround can disappear.

• Join customer and prospect calls as the technical voice alongside Solution Consultants and Account Managers.

About you

You’re an experienced industrial automation engineer, as happy with a screwdriver as with a terminal. You know how factories work, and you’re comfortable saying “not directly, but here’s the route.”

You document like the next person depends on it, because they do. You can’t leave a clunky process alone: you always have an eye on how to make things simpler and more repeatable.

You’re flexible and self-directed: you take a high level of accountability and ownership. You can prioritize and deliver without daily supervision, and you troubleshoot systematically when things get ambiguous. The work changes week to week, and the team’s shape will keep evolving as Factbird grows. You’re happy to do what’s needed today while helping move things in a more scalable direction.

You love being the expert, but you equally love teaching others and making the teams around you smarter. And most of all, you care about making the answer simple for whoever asked.

Requirements:

• A bachelor's degree in automation, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or similar, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• At least 5 years in industrial automation or controls engineering, including hands-on work on the shop floor (7+ years preferred).

• Hands-on PLC experience with at least one major vendor, e.g. Siemens, Omron, or Rockwell/Allen-Bradley.

• Solid understanding of industrial protocols, e.g. OPC UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, MQTT.

• Working knowledge of sensors and signals, like digital, analog (4–20 mA, 0–10 V), IO-Link, PNP/NPN, and energy metering.

• Root cause analysis across hardware, networks, and software in live production environments.

• Field experience commissioning or troubleshooting equipment in live plants.

• Comfortable troubleshooting site networks, e.g. IP setup, routers, SIMs, and firewalls.

• A clear communicator in English who can explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.

• A strong documentation habit: when you build it, you write it down.

Why Factbird?

People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Khristel, our Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Lead at khma@factbird.com
